name: Airkas Scroll Progress
author: Sakriya Gurung

sections.description:
Airkas Scroll Progress adds a lightweight reading progress indicator to your WordPress website.

The progress bar automatically updates as visitors scroll through a page, giving them a visual indication of their reading progress.

The plugin is designed to be simple, lightweight, and easy to configure.

Features

  • Enable or disable the progress bar.
  • Display the progress bar at the top or bottom of the screen.
  • Customize the progress bar color.
  • Customize the progress bar height.
  • Lightweight frontend implementation.
  • Works with classic themes and block themes.
  • No external services required.
  • No jQuery dependency required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the airkas-scroll-progress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Airkas Scroll Progress in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable the progress bar.
  5. Configure the position, color, percentage, and height.
  6. Click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work with block themes?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with both classic WordPress themes and block themes.

Can I change the position of the progress bar?

Yes. You can display the progress bar at the top or bottom of the screen.

Can I change the color?

Yes. You can choose a custom progress bar color from the plugin settings.

Can I change the height?

Yes. You can customize the progress bar height in pixels.

Does the plugin use JavaScript?

Yes. JavaScript is used to calculate the visitor’s scroll position and update the progress bar.

Does the plugin require jQuery?

No. The progress bar uses vanilla JavaScript.
